notes.title: Major improvements released!
notes.content:
We have fixed the following issues for a better game experience! Hope you continue to enjoy the enchanting world of Alphadia I & II!

- Added explanations about Cross Events at the start of a new game in "Alphadia I".
- Adjusted some UI elements in town shops.
- Fixed a bug where receiving the awards of the Catalog in bulk would not function correctly under specific conditions.
- Corrected some typos.
- Fixed a bug where unintended frame rates were set depending on the monitor environment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2476500/Alphadia_I__II/
